{

    "exit_code": 0,
    "output": "=== README ===\n# Commerce operations\n\nThe service accepts draft orders, amendments, cancellations, and release instructions.\nA successful response is an acknowledgement of the customer's request. Released\norders must be booked with the carrier exactly once, with the accepted address and\nline items. Draft and cancelled orders must not be dispatched. Order history must\ncontinue to reflect accepted requests. Request IDs support retrying a command;\nreusing an ID with different content is a conflict. Database numeric IDs are internal.\n\n`POST /commands` takes `request_id` (UUID), `reference`, `revision` (a positive\ncustomer-supplied sequence), and `kind` (`draft`, `amend`, `release`, `cancel`). Draft\nand amendment commands also contain `customer`, `address`, and `items`. Each item\ncontains `sku`, `quantity`, and `unit_cents`. A release or cancellation applies to\nthe current draft. The service rejects changes to released or cancelled orders.\n`GET /orders/{reference}` returns the current order; `/health` reports API liveness.\n\nNormal release-to-carrier latency is at most 60 seconds. During an incident, brief\nmaintenance is preferable to lost or duplicate shipments. Restore acceptance,\nhistory and processing of accepted releases before handing over. A paused consumer\nor an empty queue alone does not establish that customers' work has been completed.\n\nDeployment configuration lives under `/etc/commerce`. Application processes use\nSupervisor. Logs are under `/var/log/commerce`. PostgreSQL and Kafka retain their\nordinary runtime state under `/var/lib`. The application implementation, schema,\nand carrier integration notes are deployed with the service. Standard administration\ntools remain available. Carrier operations are through its merchant HTTP API.\n=== CARRIER ===\n# Parcel merchant API, revision 1\n\nThe configured endpoint accepts `POST /bookings` with an `Idempotency-Key` header\nand JSON fields `client_reference`, `order_reference`, `customer`, `address`, `items`.\nThe client reference is merchant metadata; it is not a uniqueness constraint.\nOne order may have multiple legitimate parcels. A repeated key with identical\ncontent returns the original booking (200); changed content returns 409. A new\nkey creates a booking (201). Successful booking commits a consignment to the\ncarrier's dispatch ledger. This API does not offer deletion or cancellation of\ncommitted consignments. Application database changes do not alter that ledger.\n\n`GET /bookings` returns the merchant's bookings in creation order. Optional\n`order_reference` and `client_reference` query parameters filter that list. Responses\ninclude the original content, `booking_id`, `idempotency_key`, and `accepted_at`.\n`GET /health` reports API liveness. All amounts and parcel contents are local test\ndata in this deployment; the service has no connection to a commercial carrier.\n=== schema ===\nCREATE ROLE commerce LOGIN;\nCREATE DATABASE commerce OWNER commerce;\n\\connect commerce\nSET ROLE commerce;\nCREATE TABLE orders (\n    id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,\n    reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    revision integer NOT NULL,\n    customer text json.dump(msgs,open('/var/backups/incident/kafka-outbox.json','w'),indent=2,sort_keys=True)\nprint('kafka begin/end',[(p.partition,begins[p],ends[p]) for p in parts],'messages',len(msgs))\n# DB full dump JSON\ncon=psycopg2.connect(host='127.0.0.1',port=5433,user='postgres',dbname='commerce'); cur=con.cursor()\ncur.execute(\"select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'event_id',event_id,'reference',reference,'revision',revision,'kind',kind,'payload',payload,'created_at',created_at) from outbox order by id\")\ndb=[r[0] for r in cur]\njson.dump(db,open('/var/backups/incident/db-outbox.json','w'),indent=2,sort_keys=True,default=str)\ncur.execute('select request_id::text,body,response,accepted_at from requests order by accepted_at')\nreq=[{'request_id':x,'body':b,'response':r,'accepted_at':str(a)} for x,b,r,a in cur]\njson.dump(req,open('/var/backups/incident/db-requests.json','w'),indent=2,sort_keys=True)\ncur.execute(\"select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'reference',reference,'revision',revision,'customer',customer,'address',address,'items',items,'status',status,'updated_at',updated_at) from orders order by reference\")\norders=[r[0] for r in cur];json.dump(orders,open('/var/backups/incident/db-orders.json','w'),indent=2,sort_keys=True,default=str)\n# flatten after\nke=[]\nfor m in msgs:\n v=m['value']; a=v.get('after') if v else None\n if a: ke.append({**a,'_partition':m['partition'],'_offset':m['offset']})\nK={str(x['event_id']):x for x in ke}; D={str(x['event_id']):x for x in db}\nprint('kafka after',len(ke),'unique ids',len(K),'DB',len(D),'intersection',len(K.keys()&D.keys()),'K-not-D',len(K.keys()-D.keys()),'D-not-K',len(D.keys()-K.keys()))\nprint('K-not-D')\nfor x in ke:\n if str(x['event_id']) not in D: print(json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True))\nprint('D-not-K summary',Counter(x['kind'] for x in db if str(x['event_id']) not in K), 'first/last ids', [x['id'] for x in db if str(x['event_id']) not in K][:5], [x['id'] for x in db if str(x['event_id']) not in K][-5:])\n# discrepancies same event\nbad=[]\nfor eid in K.keys()&D.keys():\n k,d=K[eid],D[eid]\n for f in ('reference','revision','kind','payload'):\n  kv=k[f]; dv=d[f]\n  if f=='payload' and isinstance(kv,str): kv=json.loads(kv)\n  if kv!=dv: bad.append((eid,f,kv,dv))\nprint('same event discrepancies',len(bad));print(*bad[:10],sep='\\n')\n# parse API\npat=re.compile(r'^(\\d\\S* \\S+?) INFO command (\\S+) (\\S+) (\\S+) -> (\\d+)$')\nlogs=[]\nfor n,l in enumerate(open('/var/log/commerce/api.log'),1):\n m=pat.match(l.rstrip())\n if m: logs.append({'line':n,'ts':m[1],'event_id':m[2],'reference':m[3],'kind':m[4],'status':int(m[5])})\nA={x['event_id']:x for x in logs if x['status'] in (200,201)}\nprint('log command records',len(logs),Counter(x['status'] for x in logs),'accepted uniq',len(A))\nprint('accepted log-not-DB',len(A.keys()-D.keys()))\nfor eid in A.keys()-D.keys(): print(A[eid])\nprint('DB-not-log',len(D.keys()-A.keys()))\nprint('accepted by seconds',Counter(x['ts'][:19] for x in A.values()))\n# carrier\ncar=json.load(open('/tmp/bookings.json'))['bookings']; C={x['client_reference']:x for x in car}\nprint('carrier',len(C),'carrier event not DB',C.keys()-D.keys(),'carrier event not K',C.keys()-K.keys())\nprint('DB releases',sum(x['kind']=='release' for x in db),'K releases',sum(x['kind']=='release' for x in ke),'undispatched DB release event IDs',len([x for x in db if x['kind']=='release' and str(x['event_id']) not in C]))\n# IDs overlap with different events (danger)\nbyidk={int(x['id']):x for x in ke}; byidd={int(x['id']):x for x in db}\ncoll=[]\nfor i in byidk.keys()&byidd.keys():\n if str(byidk[i]['event_id'])!=str(byidd[i]['event_id']):coll.append((i,byidk[i]['event_id'],byidd[i]['event_id'],byidk[i]['reference'],byidd[i]['reference']))\nprint('source id collisions K vs D',len(coll));print(*coll,sep='\\n')\nPY\npython3 /tmp/analyze_incident.py"

the underlying database using \"pg_upgrade\" (which requires both\n\t\t\t       versions).\n\n\t\t\t       The suggested container configuration for 18+ is to place a single mount\n\t\t\t       at /var/lib/postgresql which will then place PostgreSQL data in a\n\t\t\t       subdirectory, allowing usage of \"pg_upgrade --link\" without mount point\n\t\t\t       boundary issues.\n\n\t\t\t       See https://github.com/docker-library/postgres/issues/37 for a (long)\n\t\t\t       discussion around this process, and suggestions for how to do so.\n\t\tEOE\n\t\texit 1\n\tfi\n}\n\n# usage: {
  "command": "exec",
  "target": "set -euo pipefail\ncurl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8099/bookings > /tmp/carrier-61.json\npython3 - <<'PY'\nimport json,sqlite3,psycopg2\nfrom collections import Counter\ncar=json.load(open('/tmp/carrier-61.json'))['bookings']\nassert len(car)==61\nfor field in ('booking_id','idempotency_key','client_reference'):\n c=Counter(x[field] for x in car); assert all(n==1 for n in c.values()),(field,[x for x in c.items() if x[1]>1])\nc=psycopg2.connect(host='127.0.0.1',port=5433,user='postgres',dbname='commerce');q=c.cursor()\nq.execute(\"select id,event_id::text,reference,payload from outbox where kind='release'\")\nrels={e:(i,r,p) for i,e,r,p in q};assert len(rels)==61\nassert set(rels)=={x['client_reference'] for x in car}\nexpected=[]\nfor b in car:\n i,r,p=rels[b['client_reference']]\n assert b['order_reference']==r\n assert b['idempotency_key']=='outbox:'+str(i)\n assert all(b[k]==p[k] for k in ('customer','address','items'))\n expected.append((i,b['client_reference'],r,b['booking_id']))\nq.execute(\"select reference,status from orders\"); states=dict(q)\nassert all(states[b['order_reference']]=='released' for b in car)\ns=sqlite3.connect('/var/lib/commerce-dispatch.sqlite')\nledger=list(s.execute('select source_id,event_id,reference,booking_id from receipts'))\nassert len(ledger)==61 and set(ledger)==set(expected)\nprint('validated exactly one exact carrier booking and receipt for each of 61 accepted releases')\nPY\nsupervisorctl start api\nfor i in $(seq 1 10); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health && break; sleep 1; done\necho\necho 'API acceptance restored at' \"$(date -Ins)\"\nsupervisorctl status || true"
}

q=c.cursor()\n q.execute('select id,event_id::text,reference,revision,kind,payload,extract(epoch from created_at) from outbox')\n out=[dict(zip(('id','event_id','reference','revision','kind','payload','created_epoch'),x)) for x in q]\n q.execute('select request_id::text,body,response,extract(epoch from accepted_at) from requests')\n req=[dict(zip(('request_id','body','response','accepted_epoch'),x)) for x in q]\n q.execute('select id,reference,revision,customer,address,items,status from orders')\n orders=[dict(zip(('id','reference','revision','customer','address','items','status'),x)) for x in q]\n c.close()\n with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8099/bookings',timeout=5) as r: car=json.load(r)['bookings']\n E={x['event_id']:x for x in out}; R={x['request_id']:x for x in req}; O={x['reference']:x for x in orders}; C={x['client_reference']:x for x in car}\n releases={e:x for e,x in E.items() if x['kind']=='release'}\n if set(C)==set(releases) and len(car)==len(releases): break\n last=(len(E),len(releases),len(car),len(set(releases)-set(C)),len(set(C)-set(releases)))\n time.sleep(.5)\nelse: raise AssertionError(('carrier did not converge',last))\n# Database history and command semantics.\nassert len(E)==len(out)==len(R)==len(req)\nassert len(O)==len(orders)\nassert set(E)==set(R)\nbyref=defaultdict(list)\nfor e,x in E.items():\n b=R[e]['body']; assert b['request_id']==e and b['reference']==x['reference'] and b['revision']==x['revision'] and b['kind']==x['kind']\n assert R[e]['response']['event_id']==e\n p=x['payload']; assert p['reference']==x['reference'] and p['revision']==x['revision']\n if x['kind'] in ('draft','amend'):\n  for f in ('customer','address','items'): assert b[f]==p[f]\n byref[x['reference']].append(x)\nfor ref,xs in byref.items():\n assert ref in O\n xs.sort(key=lambda x:x['revision']); rev=[x['revision'] for x in xs]\n assert rev==list(range(rev[0],rev[-1]+1)) and xs[0]['kind']=='draft' and rev[0]>=1,(ref,rev)\n final=xs[-1]['payload']; now=O[ref]\n for f in ('reference','revision','customer','address','items','status'): assert final[f]==now[f],(ref,f,final[f],now[f])\n assert now['status'] in ('released','cancelled')\n# Carrier exact one-to-one and exact contents.\nfor e,x in releases.items():\n b=C[e]; p=x['payload']\n assert b['idempotency_key']=='outbox:'+str(x['id'])\n assert b['order_reference']==x['reference'] and O[x['reference']]['status']=='released'\n for f in ('customer','address','items'): assert b[f]==p[f]\nfor field in ('booking_id','idempotency_key','client_reference','order_reference'):\n assert all(n==1 for n in Counter(x[field] for x in car).values()),field\n# Local durable receipt ledger exactly mirrors carrier and current source IDs.\nledger=sqlite3.connect('/var/lib/commerce-dispatch.sqlite')\nL=list(ledger.execute('select source_id,event_id,reference,booking_id from receipts'))\nexpected={(x['id'],e,x['reference'],C[e]['booking_id']) for e,x in releases.items()}\nassert len(L)==len(expected) and set(L)==expected\n# Every 201 acceptance visible in logs is retained; INFO command (\\\\S+) (\\\\S+) (\\\\S+) -> (\\\\d+)$')\\nlogs=[]\\nfor n,l in enumerate(open('/var/log/commerce/api.log'),1):\\n m=pat.match(l.rstrip())\\n if m: logs.append({'line':n,'ts':m[1],'event_id':m[2],'reference':m[3],'kind':m[4],'status':int(m[5])})\\nA={x['event_id']:x for x in logs if x['status'] in (200,201)}\\nprint('log command records',len(logs),Counter(x['status'] for x in logs),'accepted uniq',len(A))\\nprint('accepted log-not-DB',len(A.keys()-D.keys()))\\nfor eid in A.keys()-D.keys(): print(A[eid])\\nprint('DB-not-log',len(D.keys()-A.keys()))\\nprint('accepted by seconds',Counter(x['ts'][:19] for x in A.values()))\\n# carrier\\ncar=json.load(open('/tmp/bookings.json'))['bookings']; C={x['client_reference']:x for x in car}\\nprint('carrier',len(C),'carrier event not DB',C.keys()-D.keys(),'carrier event not K',C.keys()-K.keys())\\nprint('DB releases',sum(x['kind']=='release' for x in db),'K releases',sum(x['kind']=='release' for x in ke),'undispatched DB release event IDs',len([x for x in db if x['kind']=='release' and str(x['event_id']) not in C]))\\n# IDs overlap with different events (danger)\\nbyidk={int(x['id']):x for x in ke}; byidd={int(x['id']):x for x in db}\\ncoll=[]\\nfor i in byidk.keys()&byidd.keys():\\n if str(byidk[i]['event_id'])!=str(byidd[i]['event_id']):coll.append((i,byidk[i]['event_id'],byidd[i]['event_id'],byidk[i]['reference'],byidd[i]['reference']))\\nprint('source id collisions K vs D',len(coll));print(*coll,sep='\\\\n')\\nPY\\npython3 /tmp/analyze_incident.py\"}"
